ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter at {H:1810541097000}

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between the Moon and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.
